title: Step-by-Step Guide: Applying LDA for Feature Extraction in Machine Learning

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So in the previous section, this PCA feature extraction technique reduced the dimensionality of our problem by extracting the variables that explained the most, the variants.
cues.zh: 上一節的 PCA 特徵擷取，透過擷取最能解釋變異的變數，降低問題的維度。

cues.en: And now in LDA this is quite different.
cues.zh: LDA 則很不一樣。

cues.en: We are extracting some new independent variables that will separate the most, the classes of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 它擷取新的自變數，盡可能分開依變數的類別。

cues.en: And therefore, since this time it considers the classes of the dependent variable, well, that means that it considers the dependent variable to proceed to this feature extraction technique
cues.zh: 因此這次會考慮依變數的類別，也就是在進行特徵擷取時，考慮依變數，

cues.en: and therefore that makes LDA a supervised dimensionality reduction model.
cues.zh: 所以 LDA 是監督式降維模型。

cues.en: All right, so now let's supply LDA on R.
cues.zh: 現在在 R 裡套用 LDA。

cues.en: So first very quickly, let's set the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 先快速將正確資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So we'll go to our machine learning, erase that folder, part nine dimensionality reduction.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾，再進入 Part 9 Dimensionality Reduction。

cues.en: And we are now in the section 44, linear discriminant analysis.
cues.zh: 目前是第 44 節，Linear Discriminant Analysis。

cues.en: So let's go inside and that's the folder you wanna set as working directory.
cues.zh: 進去，這就是要設為工作目錄的資料夾。

cues.en: We are still working on the one .CSV file, so that's exactly the same business problem as the one we worked with when implementing PCA.
cues.zh: 仍使用 Wine.csv，所以和 PCA 實作是相同的商業問題。

cues.en: And so that will be a good opportunity to compare this dimensionality reduction technique, LDA to the previous one, PCA.
cues.zh: 正好可以比較 LDA 與先前的 PCA 降維技術。

cues.en: So now let's not forget to click on this more button here and set as working directory.
cues.zh: 別忘記按 More，再選 Set As Working Directory。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And so since we're working on the same business problem as before, as for PCA, well, implementing LDA here is going to be very easy, we will just take the PCA code,
cues.zh: 既然商業問題和 PCA 相同，這裡實作 LDA 會非常簡單，只要取用 PCA 程式碼，

cues.en: take everything from here down to the bottom, copy and we'll go back to LDA and paste the whole thing here.
cues.zh: 從這裡選到底，複製，再回到 LDA 全部貼上。

cues.en: And inside of this code, we will just need basically to replace this applying PCA section by a new section dedicated to applying LDA.
cues.zh: 裡面基本上只需要把 Applying PCA 區段，換成專門套用 LDA 的區段。

cues.en: So I'm going to remove all this section.
cues.zh: 所以移除這一整段。

cues.en: So let's remove this and let's replace here PCA by LDA.
cues.zh: 刪掉，再把這裡的 PCA 換成 LDA。

cues.en: And now it's time to implement LDA.
cues.zh: 現在開始實作 LDA。

cues.en: So the package that we're gonna use to apply LDA is the MASS package, M-A-S-S, and it's actually a package that is by default in your list of packages.
cues.zh: 要使用的套件是 MASS，M-A-S-S，它預設就會出現在套件清單。

cues.en: It's the package right here, MASS, support functions, and dataset for enables and replace MASS.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的 MASS，提供相關支援函式與資料集。

cues.en: All right, so as you can see, this is not imported, so let's import it by using the library command.
cues.zh: 可以看到還沒載入，所以使用 library 指令載入。

cues.en: Here we go, and MASS this way in parenthesis.
cues.zh: 像這樣，括號裡放 MASS。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: We can already select this to import the package.
cues.zh: 現在就可以選取並載入套件。

cues.en: And now let's implement LDA.
cues.zh: 接著實作 LDA。

cues.en: So the first thing that we have to do is, as for PCA, create an LDA variable that we will use to transform our original data set into this new data set
cues.zh: 首先和 PCA 一樣，建立 lda 變數，用來將原始資料集轉換為新的資料集，

cues.en: composed of the linear discriminates.
cues.zh: 包含線性判別成分。

cues.en: And so we're gonna call this variable LDA equals, and now we're gonna use the LDA function as simple as that.
cues.zh: 將變數命名為 lda，等於，再使用 lda 函式，就這麼簡單。

cues.en: And let's add some parenthesis, and now let's see the arguments by pressing F1.
cues.zh: 加上括號，按 F1 看看參數。

cues.en: All right, so the arguments are here.
cues.zh: 參數在這裡。

cues.en: The first argument is formula.
cues.zh: 第一個是 formula。

cues.en: So that's exactly the formula of your dependent variable with respect to the independent variables, so far the original ones.
cues.zh: 也就是依變數與自變數的公式，目前仍是原始自變數。

cues.en: So here as a first argument, we will input formula equals customer segment.
cues.zh: 所以第一個參數輸入 formula = Customer_Segment。

cues.en: Remember that's the name of the dependent variable and Tilda.
cues.zh: 記得這是依變數名稱，再加波浪號。

cues.en: And we can add a dot, don't worry, we don't have to write all the names of the independent variables, the dot is here for us.
cues.zh: 接著可以加上一個點，別擔心，不用寫出所有自變數名稱，這個點就能代表它們。

cues.en: So comma, and then next argument.
cues.zh: 加逗號，下一個參數。

cues.en: And then the next argument is data, and as for PCA, the data here is going to be the training set.
cues.zh: 下一個是 data，和 PCA 一樣，資料用訓練集。

cues.en: So let's add here training set, here we go.
cues.zh: 所以這裡加入 training_set。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And actually that's all.
cues.zh: 其實這樣就好了。

cues.en: And that's for a specific reason, a very important reason that is directly related to LDA.
cues.zh: 這有一個特定且重要的原因，與 LDA 本身直接相關。

cues.en: It's due to the fact that LDA is a supervised dimensionality reduction technique.
cues.zh: 因為 LDA 是監督式降維技術。

cues.en: Remember, supervised means that the LDA model takes into account the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 記得，監督式代表 LDA 模型會考慮依變數。

cues.en: And since it takes into account the dependent variable, well, it's quite intuitive to understand that the number of linear discriminants will be related
cues.zh: 既然考慮依變數，就不難理解，線性判別成分的數量會與

cues.en: to the information of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 依變數資訊有關。

cues.en: And that information is actually the number of classes in the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這項資訊，實際上就是依變數的類別數量。

cues.en: And there is this explicit correlation between the number of linear discriminants and the information of the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 線性判別成分數與依變數資訊之間，有這個明確關係。

cues.en: It's that there will be K minus one linear discriminants where K is the number of classes.
cues.zh: 最多有 K - 1 個線性判別成分，其中 K 是類別數量。

cues.en: So here, since we have three classes, that means that we'll get it most, three minus one equals two linear discriminants.
cues.zh: 這裡有三個類別，所以最多得到 3 - 1 = 2 個線性判別成分。

cues.en: So here, without specifying the number of linear discriminants equal to two, we will get automatically two linear discriminants, and therefore that's all,
cues.zh: 不用指定成分數為 2，就會自動得到兩個線性判別成分，因此

cues.en: we don't need to add any other argument.
cues.zh: 不需要其他參數。

cues.en: So the LDA object is ready to be used to transform our original data set into this new one composed of the linear discriminants.
cues.zh: lda 物件可以用來轉換原始資料集，變成包含線性判別成分的新資料集。

cues.en: We will get two linear discriminants which is exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 會得到兩個成分，正好符合需求。

cues.en: As for PCA, we want two new extracted features, and this time these two new extracted features will separate the most two classes.
cues.zh: 和 PCA 一樣，要兩個新擷取特徵；這次它們會盡可能區分類別。

cues.en: So we should get very good results as well.
cues.zh: 所以應該也會得到好結果。

cues.en: And then that's the same as for PCA.
cues.zh: 接著和 PCA 相同。

cues.en: We need to transform the training set and the test set so that we can then use them in the next sections.
cues.zh: 需要轉換訓練集與測試集，才能在後續區段使用。

cues.en: So we will use the training set to fit SVM, well, actually to the training set to build the classifier.
cues.zh: 使用訓練集擬合 SVM，也就是建立分類器。

cues.en: And then we will make our predictions predicting the tested set results with this test set that will be transformed as well and make the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 再用轉換後的測試集預測結果，建立混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And most importantly, we will visualize the training set and the test set results, something that we'll be able to do because we now have two features.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，現在只有兩個特徵，因此能視覺化訓練集與測試集結果。

cues.en: All right, so let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Let's do the same to apply LDA on the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 和前面一樣，將 LDA 套用到訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So first, let's start with the training set.
cues.zh: 先從訓練集開始。

cues.en: Training set.
cues.zh: training_set。

cues.en: So remember, we're keeping this name as a training set so that we don't have to change it in the rest of the sections.
cues.zh: 記得保留 training_set 這個名稱，就不用改後面其他區段。

cues.en: So training set equals, and then remember we need to use the predict function that's actually exactly the same as for PCA.
cues.zh: training_set 等於，接著記得使用 predict，這和 PCA 完全相同。

cues.en: We will however need to add something to make it work, and I will explain what it is.
cues.zh: 不過需要再加一點內容才能運作，我會解釋。

cues.en: But definitely we are doing this transformation with the predict function, so parenthesis.
cues.zh: 確實使用 predict 做轉換，所以加上括號。

cues.en: And now inside this predict function, we need to specify the first argument here, which is the object.
cues.zh: predict 裡的第一個參數，需要指定物件。

cues.en: So the object is LDA and then comma, and then the second argument.
cues.zh: 物件是 lda，再加逗號、第二個參數。

cues.en: And the second argument is the data set on which we wanna make the transformation that is extract the new features and that's the training set.
cues.zh: 第二個參數是要轉換、擷取新特徵的資料集，也就是 training_set。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So as a reminder, this is the original data set composed of the 13 independent variables.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這是原本包含 13 個自變數的資料集。

cues.en: And this will be the new training set composed of the two new extracted features that are the two linear discriminants.
cues.zh: 這會是包含兩個新擷取特徵，也就是兩個線性判別成分的新訓練集。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So we can already do that to see if we get the right training set as we expect.
cues.zh: 現在就可以試試看，是否得到預期的訓練集。

cues.en: So before executing this line, of course, we need to execute the previous sections because we need to import the data set and apply data pre processing.
cues.zh: 執行這行前，當然要先執行前面的區段，匯入資料集並前處理。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: We don't have anything to change here, everything is already well prepared, thanks to what we did in the previous section with PCA.
cues.zh: 這裡不必修改，因為上一節 PCA 已經準備好了。

cues.en: So let's execute this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: Here we go, well executed.
cues.zh: 好了，成功執行。

cues.en: And now let's apply LDA, create the LDA object, and then use this object to transform our original training set into this new training set
cues.zh: 現在套用 LDA，建立 lda 物件，再用它將原始訓練集轉換成新訓練集，

cues.en: composed of the two linear discriminants.
cues.zh: 包含兩個線性判別成分。

cues.en: So we already imported the MASS package, so we just need to execute this line of code.
cues.zh: MASS 已載入，所以只要執行這一行。

cues.en: Let's do it, here we go, LDA object well created and now we are ready to transform the training set.
cues.zh: 來做吧，lda 物件建立好了，現在可以轉換訓練集。

cues.en: But before we select this line and execute it, we need to add this one more thing that I just mentioned, which is a function that we will apply
cues.zh: 但選取執行之前，需要加入剛才提到的額外內容，也就是一個函式，套用到

cues.en: to this whole predict LDA training set here.
cues.zh: 這整個 predict(lda, training_set) 結果。

cues.en: And that will set this training set that will be transformed into a data frame.
cues.zh: 它會將轉換後的訓練集設為資料框。

cues.en: Because for PCA, when we did this, when we transformed here the training set to this new training set composed to the principle components, well, we got a data frame,
cues.zh: PCA 做這個轉換時，得到包含主成分的新訓練集，結果已是資料框，

cues.en: but for LDA that's not the same.
cues.zh: 但 LDA 不一樣。

cues.en: We will get a matrix and we need a data frame because then you know we have the next code sections.
cues.zh: 這裡會得到矩陣，而我們需要資料框，因為後續程式碼區段，

cues.en: And inside these code sections, the functions that we use expect a data frame for the training set.
cues.zh: 裡面的函式預期訓練集是資料框。

cues.en: Here, for example, it expects a data frame.
cues.zh: 例如這裡就需要資料框。

cues.en: And so we absolutely need to convert this transform training set that will not be a data frame if we execute it this way, but a matrix.
cues.zh: 所以必須轉換格式，否則直接這樣執行，轉換後的資料不是資料框，而是矩陣。

cues.en: And so to simply convert this into a data frame, I think we already did it before, we need to use the function as.data.frame
cues.zh: 要轉成資料框，我想先前做過，使用 as.data.frame 函式，

cues.en: and parenthesis and we close the parenthesis here, and that will set this transform training set as a data frame.
cues.zh: 加左括號，再在這裡補右括號，讓轉換後的訓練集成為資料框。

cues.en: And now we are ready to execute this line of code to obtain our new training set composed of the extracted features, the linear discriminants.
cues.zh: 現在可以執行，取得包含新擷取特徵，也就是線性判別成分的新訓練集。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Let's select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行並執行。

cues.en: And as you can see, the training set is still a training set, otherwise it would be in values.
cues.zh: 可以看到，training_set 仍列在資料區，否則會顯示在 Values。

cues.en: And when I click on it, let's have a look at what we just created.
cues.zh: 點開看看剛建立的內容。

cues.en: So first of all, the first thing that we see is this first column here, that is the dependent variable itself.
cues.zh: 首先看到第一欄，是依變數本身。

cues.en: I know this is no longer called customer segment, but it's actually the customer segment column that's exactly the same one for the same observations and the same labels, one, two, and three,
cues.zh: 我知道它不再叫 Customer_Segment，但這就是顧客區隔欄，對應相同觀測資料，以及相同的 1、2、3 標籤，

cues.en: but automatically it was called class by predict function.
cues.zh: 只是 predict 自動將它命名為 class。

cues.en: So don't worry about that, that's the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 所以別擔心，這就是依變數。

cues.en: And then the next interesting thing we see are the two linear discriminants, LD1 and LD2.
cues.zh: 接著有趣的是兩個線性判別成分，LD1 與 LD2。

cues.en: And as I told you, that's the number of linear discriminants we get due to the fact that we have three classes for the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，因為依變數有三個類別，所以得到這個數量的線性判別成分。

cues.en: So that's what matters for us now and that's the variables that we'll use.
cues.zh: 這些才是現在重要、要使用的變數。

cues.en: That's the new extracted features that we'll use to train the SVM model to make the predictions, to make the confusion matrix, and eventually to visualize the results.
cues.zh: 將用新擷取特徵訓練 SVM、做預測、建立混淆矩陣，最後視覺化結果。

cues.en: And then we have this other three variables, posterior one, posterior two, and posterior three.
cues.zh: 另外還有三個變數，posterior.1、posterior.2、posterior.3。

cues.en: That is just variables derived from the LDA model equations.
cues.zh: 它們是 LDA 模型方程式衍生的變數。

cues.en: So that's not very important here.
cues.zh: 這裡不是重點。

cues.en: What matters is that we have our dependent variable class and our two new extracted features, the linear discriminants one and two.
cues.zh: 重要的是依變數 class，以及兩個新擷取特徵，第一、第二線性判別成分。

cues.en: And so now what we have to do is set our training set into the right format.
cues.zh: 現在需要把訓練集整理成正確格式。

cues.en: That is we want a training set that is composed of first, the two extracted features, the two new independent variables, and then in last position, the dependent variable class
cues.zh: 也就是前面先放兩個擷取特徵、兩個新的自變數，最後放依變數 class，

cues.en: that is nothing else in the customer segment.
cues.zh: 也就是 Customer_Segment。

cues.en: So basically, what we need to do here is the same as what we did for PCA, that is play with the indexes to not only set the right order for our columns,
cues.zh: 基本上，和 PCA 做相同處理，運用索引，不只調整欄位順序，

cues.en: but also to not include the three columns here, posterior one, posterior two, and posterior three.
cues.zh: 也排除這三欄 posterior.1、posterior.2、posterior.3。

cues.en: So what we'll do here to be efficient is take our PCA model and we will take this line here, copy
cues.zh: 為了效率，回到 PCA 模型，複製這一行，

cues.en: and go back to LDA and paste that here.
cues.zh: 再回到 LDA，貼在這裡。

cues.en: All right, and now as for PCA, we need to include three indexes.
cues.zh: 和 PCA 一樣，需要三個索引。

cues.en: This first index here will be the index of LD1.
cues.zh: 第一個索引，應是 LD1 的索引。

cues.en: So that is the index of this column, that is one, two, three, four, and five.
So that's index five.
cues.zh: 所以索引是 5。

cues.en: So let's add it here, replace two by five.
cues.zh: 放在這裡，把 2 換成 5。

cues.en: Then the second index here should be the index of the second new extracted feature, that is LD2.
cues.zh: 第二個索引，應是第二個新擷取特徵 LD2 的索引。

cues.en: So that is index six, this column has index six, so let's replace here three by six.
cues.zh: 它是索引 6，這欄的索引是 6，所以把 3 換成 6。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And eventually, this should be the index of the dependent variable, And this index is of course one because this is the first column here that has index one.
cues.zh: 最後是依變數索引，當然是 1，因為它在第一欄，索引為 1。

cues.en: So now when I execute this line, here we go, look at our new training set.
cues.zh: 現在執行這行，看看新的訓練集。

cues.en: Well, that is this time exactly what we want.
cues.zh: 這次正是我們要的內容。

cues.en: The first two columns are the new extracted features and the last column is the dependent viable vector exactly as what is expected in the rest of the code sections.
cues.zh: 前兩欄是新擷取特徵，最後一欄是依變數向量，完全符合後續程式碼區段的要求。

cues.en: So perfect, our training set is well transformed and ready to be used to train the SVM model.
cues.zh: 很好，訓練集轉換完成，可以用來訓練 SVM。

cues.en: All right, now we need to do the same for the test set, so that will be very quick and easy.
cues.zh: 接著對測試集做相同處理，很快又簡單。

cues.en: We will select these tool lines here, copy, paste.
cues.zh: 選取這兩行、複製、貼上。

cues.en: And now we just need to replace training set by test set here, here as well, here, and eventually here also.
cues.zh: 把這裡的 training_set 換成 test_set，這裡、這裡，以及最後這裡都一樣。

cues.en: And now we can just execute these two lines, but let's execute them one by one.
cues.zh: 現在可以執行這兩行，不過一行一行來。
